items.title: Marvell Technology vs. Broadcom: Comparing Revenue Trends Between These Artificial Intelligence Companies
items.summary: Broadcom's latest quarter revenue hit $29.6 billion — nearly 11 times Marvell's $2.7 billion — with both companies posting steady gains over the past two years.

items.title: Can Marvell Stock Make You Money Before Its Hyperscaler Deal Pays Off?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) trades at $235.01, and it has expanded its agreement with a key hyperscaler, a deal analysts size at up to $120 billion of revenue over about six and a half years. Most of that money, though, arrives after the fiscal 2028 outlook you would be paying for today.

items.title: Is Marvell The Broad Chip Business You Think You Own?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) raised its revenue outlook again with its fiscal Q2 2027 results in late August. The size of the raise is the easy story. What fell out of management's script matters more, because the business you own has narrowed toward a single bet.
